title: Draw face-metric guides with the shared metricsSpecimen helper, not a new copy
rule: When a UI part draws lines or a box from a face's vertical metrics (ascender, descender, x-height, cap height, baseline), build it from `apps/desktop/src/preview/metricsSpecimen.ts` (`metricsSpecimen`, `specimenRulers`), extending it additively when a line is missing. fm-core passes hhea values through unnormalised, and the helper already clamps a positive descender (`min(descender, 0)`) and keeps a cap or x-height above the ascender in the box (`max(...)`). Test the new part with a positive descender and with an x-height above the ascender.
rationale: E50.7 (#578): a second specimenBox helper skipped both guards, so a face with descender +50 got a box ending above its baseline and lost its x-height ruler while the Info section drew it correctly.
